Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
If Darkness Within has been played, and the opposing
vampire (or the playing vampire, for that matter) plays
a Strike: Combat Ends, does the blood still get moved
by Darkness Within?

I thought at first that it should, since it happens
"during strike resolution" and strike resolution still
happens with S:CE (it just doesn't get far). But then
I started thinking that I remembered something about
non-strike-effects that happen "during strike resolution"
going off at the same time as "normal" strikes (eg, after
S:CE resolves). Like Wolf Companion, etc.

thanks for help,

Josh

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Joshua Duffin <jt...@cornell.edu> wrote:
> If Darkness Within has been played, and the opposing
> vampire (or the playing vampire, for that matter) plays
> a Strike: Combat Ends, does the blood still get moved
> by Darkness Within?

No.

> I thought at first that it should, since it happens
> "during strike resolution" and strike resolution still
> happens with S:CE (it just doesn't get far).

S:CE cuts combat off before any of the "during strike
resolution" effects take place (including regular
strike resolution).
